name: exception-fetch-v1
purpose: Offline: for flagged passages that exception-resolver-v2 left ambiguous, search the same source's chunk store for a requirement statement (the guide's own sentence naming what the exception waives) in a related section, and cost it in words. No generation, no retrieval-pipeline change.
inputs: Mastercard guide chunks (data/chunks-expanded/chunks-400-overlap-40.json, parent mastercard-chargeback-guide) and the saved bundle's 10 ambiguous passages. Development cases only. No model calls. Holdout not read.

rule.applicable: ambiguous passages whose exception items carry distinctive tokens (Mainland China, Latin America and the Caribbean, Germany, CAT 2); others are 'not applicable, fetch not attempted'
rule.candidate_sentence: resolver-v2 requirement statement (starts with Listing, Closing or Blocking and contains 'required') that contains at least one of the passage's exception tokens
rule.ranking: number of shared heading words (lowercased, 4+ letters, excluding generic words issuer, chargeback, submission, case, dispute, message, reason, code) between the candidate chunk's headings below chapter level and the passage's; ties broken by shorter chunk
rule.fetch_window: the candidate sentence plus the two list lines directly around it, counted in words

thresholds.T1: For E23 S007 and E15 S039 the top-ranked candidate lies under a heading path containing 'No Cardholder Authorization' and names the stem 'list'
thresholds.T2: Every fetch window is at most 120 words and at most 3 candidates are returned per passage
thresholds.T3: The 4 not-applicable passages return 'not applicable' without any search
thresholds.T4: The 4 other applicable passages each return either a candidate or 'none found'; none is dropped

decision_rule: Pass only if T1 to T4 hold. Report the top candidate for the 4 other applicable passages for source review; do not trust them until reviewed. Report each case's context headroom (6000 minus words used) against the fetch cost.
limits: Designed after reading E23 and E15, so not independent; holdout is the independent test
Token list and requirement form are Mastercard-guide specific
Heading overlap is a crude relatedness measure; every returned candidate needs source review before use
Advisory; not wired into retrieval or generation
